flawed_step: Line 0025 falsely claims that two 7-cycles can generate only C7, PSL(2,7), or S7.
counterexample: In S7, let σ=(1 2 3 4 5 6 7) and τ=(1 3 2 4 5 6 7). Both are 7-cycles, but τ=σ(1 2 3), so ⟨σ,τ⟩=⟨σ,(1 2 3)⟩. Conjugating (1 2 3) by powers of σ gives the adjacent 3-cycles (2 3 4), (3 4 5), (4 5 6), and (5 6 7); these generate A7. Thus ⟨σ,τ⟩=A7, of order 2520, which is neither C7, PSL(2,7), nor S7.
assessment_summary: The exhaustive classification used in Case 1 is refuted by this explicit pair of 7-cycles, so the conclusion that σ and τ must generate PSL(2,7) does not follow.
